product_description: GrantReady is a hypothetical nonprofit grant discovery and application-readiness concept. It exists only to demonstrate GrowthLoop AI; it is not a real product.
default_hypothesis: Opening the post on a missed grant deadline will earn more qualified demo requests per landing-page visit than opening on general team workload.

brief.audience: Development directors at small US nonprofits with fewer than 20 staff
brief.campaignGoal: Invite development directors to request a demo of the hypothetical GrantReady concept
brief.keyMessage: GrantReady is a concept for keeping grant deadlines and application materials in one place, so small teams can start preparing earlier.
